title: Connection Entity
description: JSON Schema for Connection entity in customer workspace. Connections are configured instances of connectors with credentials and settings.

workflow_id.description: Workflow this connection belongs to; null for project-level/draft connections

connector_id.description: Reference to the connector definition this connection uses; null for project-level/draft connections

sync_entity.description: For API poll connectors: which entity (e.g. orders, customers) this connection syncs. Must match connector supported_entities when present.

key.description: Unique key for the connection within the organization

type.description: Connection type: database, api, webhook, file, or connector type (e.g. spotify, shopify)

connector_type.description: Connector package type emitted on connection-created (for example data-product-trigger). Distinct from type when a template sets both.

credential_fields.description: Encrypted credential fields for the connection (structure depends on connector auth_type)

credential_parameter_store_refs.description: SSM Parameter Store paths for OAuth/credentials (keyed by credential name)

verified.description: Whether the connection has been verified/tested

draft.description: Whether this connection is still in draft state

last_tested.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when connection was last tested

created_by.description: User ID who created the connection

updated_by.description: User ID who last updated the connection

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when connection was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when connection was last updated

deleted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when connection was deleted (soft delete)

ingestion_config.description: Structured ingestion settings (schedule, batch, polling). Extensible per connection type.

schedule.description: Cron expression (LeoCron `time`) or platform-supported schedule string for this connection's registered bot. Distinct from `polling_interval_ms`, which is a millisecond gap for application-level throttling between requests—not the Leo schedule field.

primary_key.description: Business-identity field names. A top-level primary_key is still read, and the next connection save moves it here.

runtime_memory_mb.description: Shared runtimes tier for trigger registration (256–2048). Defaults to 256 when unset. LeoCron `lambdaName`: `w-{org4}-{inst4}-bot-connectors-{mb}-rtime`; bot id: `w-{org4}-{inst4}-{workflow4}-bot-connectors-{mb}-{container_id}`. Instance `connection_details.runtimes_stack_identifier` may override the org/instance middle segment (CDK `microserviceIdentifier` = `w-{that middle}`).

fetch_action_key.description: Declarative connector package action key used for polling fetches (e.g. shopify_get_orders). Often matches sync_plan entity fetch_action_key.

type.description: Ingestion mode. Use api_poll for REST pollers.

url.description: Request URL or URL template. For entity_loop include {key} (e.g. https://api.example.com/V2/products?styleID={styleID}). The rest-api runtime refuses to fire if the required key would be missing (unfiltered child collection URLs).

pagination.description: Page-to-exhaustion settings for rest-api pollers. S&S uses type=page, page_param=page, page_size_param=perPage, page_size=100, start_page=1.

page_param.description: Query param for page index. Default page.

page_size_param.description: Query param for page size (pageSize or perPage).

entity_loop.description: Generic rest-api fan-out: resolve entity keys from a parent data product or parent_poll, substitute {key} into the child URL, page each entity to exhaustion, skip per-entity 4xx, and checkpoint across scheduled runs. Not vendor-specific.

source.description: data_product uses data_product_id (optional parent_poll to enumerate keys). parent_poll pages parent_poll.url.

data_product_id.description: Parent data product that holds the entity keys (graph bind / lineage).

parent_poll.description: HTTP parent catalog used to resolve keys (page to exhaustion).

runtime_status.description: Deployment state of the connection's bot (written at deploy time)

auth_type.description: Authentication type for the connection (optional, backwards compat).

transfer_mechanism.description: How data moves for this connection (optional). Formerly ingestion_type; renamed because connector_mode now carries direction and this field only ever described mechanism.

connector_mode.description: For enrichment workflows: mid-flow connection must be 'bidirectional'. For ingestion head use 'inbound'; for delivery tail use 'outbound'. Must match connector supported_directions.

upstream_entity_id.description: Upstream entity in the flow graph (e.g. data-product in delivery flows). Null for source connections.

upstream_entity_type.description: Entity type of the upstream entity.

output_queue_display_name.description: Observe label for this connection's output queue (ingested). Deploy writes it onto the existing queue id and leaves bindings, checkpoints, and bot pause unchanged. Unset: the generated label stays the fallback and is not overwritten.

error_queue_display_name.description: Observe label for this connection's error queue. Deploy writes it onto the existing queue id and leaves bindings, checkpoints, and bot pause unchanged. Unset: the generated label stays the fallback and is not overwritten.
